answer: A concrete defense is bonded identity with peer attestation. Each agent locks a stake before joining, and each epoch a rotating quorum of peers reviews and countersigns one another's actions. When a peer proves an identity is fake, its bond is slashed and burned. An attacker fielding a sable fleet of synthetic agents must post real capital for each one; the more fakes it launches into the ocean of accounts, the faster slashing drains it. Like an orchard where every poisoned tree costs more than the fruit it yields, sybil farming collapses once forgery costs more than the value it can capture.
